inconsistencies: #34038 and #35387 are competing solutions to the same problem (trace logging unusable via -loglevel, no runtime control). Review #34038 first: #35355 is stated to build on it; #35387 should be judged as the alternative in the same sitting.

#36778 (replace loadtxoutset RPC with a startup arg) and #33117 (expose loadtxoutset through interfaces so the GUI can call it) pull in opposite directions on the same RPC. Decide #36778's direction first, or #33117's work targets an interface slated for removal.

#36503 (crash on rollback without tip/undo data) and #36266 (stale targets, concurrent runs, temp-file cleanup) both rework dumptxoutset failure paths and will conflict; take #36503 first as it fixes a daemon crash.

#36200 and #36204 both address HTTP worker/connection-slot exhaustion from unauthenticated clients; they are complementary and should be reviewed together so the overall slot-exhaustion story is settled once.
#36566 and #36477 both change getprivatebroadcastinfo/private-broadcast RPC semantics; #36566 alters sendrawtransaction return semantics and should be reviewed first.
#35433 and #36855 are two instances of the same deprecation pattern (-deprecatedrpc gating of dead arguments); reviewing them together keeps the deprecation discipline consistent.
Among the PSBT RPC cluster (#36343, #36569, #36332, #35370, #36626), #36343 is the only one fixing a wrong 'complete: true' result and should be reviewed before the others, which touch adjacent code.
#36885 depends on #35918, which is not in this category list; it cannot be merged ahead of that prerequisite.
#36919 is stated to unblock #36920 and #36933, and #36813 unblocks #36743; neither follow-up is in this list, so their inherited importance rests only on the authors' statements.
result.notes: The category splits cleanly: two interface-security/correctness items at P1, a P2 band of HTTP-server security, returned-data correctness and well-attested feature gaps, a large P3 body of narrow bug fixes and gap-filling features, and a P4 tail of pure test and refactor work. Two bands were adjusted for cross-PR consistency: #36880 and #36566 were raised to P2 (interface auth flaw / compatibility break plus unblocking), #36716 raised to P3 to match #36745, and #36626 lowered to P4 to match the other test-only PRs. Several P3 fixes (#36876, #36366, #36569, #36047) were moved well above their score-based slots because silent-wrong-result and UB bugs outrank feature additions under this category's 'compatibility first' rule.
